title: Confirm dialog
description: Final confirmation dialog for actions that cannot be undone easily.

ui.overview: The Confirm dialog is the final checkpoint before a destructive or high-impact action runs. It keeps the user in control of the last decision.

controls.label: Confirmation text
controls.description: Explains what the action will do before it runs.

controls.label: Cancel
controls.description: Stops the action and closes the dialog.

notes: Use the confirm dialog for destructive or irreversible actions.
